t.PROPYLENE_GLYCOL.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule. In food it appears as E1520.
t.PROPYLENE_GLYCOL.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.PROPYLENE_GLYCOL.what: Binds water to keep the skin moist, dissolves other ingredients and adjusts the product's viscosity.
